Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of HP Victus 16 (16-r0075TX)?

The HP Victus 16 (16-r0075TX) features a 120W TGP (with MUX switch) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

HP Victus 16 (16-r0075TX) scores 9.5/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i5-13500H (12 Cores: 4P + 8E, 16 Threads, up to 4.7 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
